newsitem.title: USA: U.S. blue chips slip at open, Nasdaq wavers.
newsitem.headline: U.S. blue chips slip at open, Nasdaq wavers.

text.p: U.S. blue chips dipped at the market open on Wednesday, after drawing strength from interest rates yesterday, while Nasdaq waffled between positive and negative ground as activity focused on the technology sector.
The Dow Jones industrial average was trading down around 26 points at 7287, as the long bond weakened slightly.
The benchmark 30-year Treasury was down 9/32 at a 6.89 percent yield.
The Nasdaq index was up 1.54 points at around 1386, after a brief foray lower. Large technology stocks like Intel Corp and International Business Machines firmed.
